reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is too generic; thermally activated dislocation glide governs plasticity in virtually all crystalline metals, so it does not provide a specific, falsifiable mechanism for the dynamic behavior of this particular alloy.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, but the falsification criterion (strain rate sensitivity independent of temperature) would only disprove a trivial, universal mechanism, not a specific hypothesis about FeNiCrMn.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is of little use because it restates a well-known general principle without addressing the unique compositional or microstructural features of the Co-free FeNiCrMn system.
